description: The ADMISSIONS table contains information on hospital admissions for patients. It includes patient demographics, admission and discharge times, admission types and locations, insurance details, diagnoses, and mortality information. This table provides a comprehensive overview of each hospital visit.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a patient's hospital admission.

columns.name: ADMITTIME
columns.description: Date and time when the patient was admitted to the hospital.

columns.name: DISCHTIME
columns.description: Date and time when the patient was discharged from the hospital.

columns.name: DEATHTIME
columns.description: Date and time when the patient died (if applicable).

columns.name: ADMISSION_TYPE
columns.description: Type of admission (e.g., URGENT, ELECTIVE, NEWBORN).

columns.name: ADMISSION_LOCATION
columns.description: Location of the patient prior to hospital admission.

columns.name: DISCHARGE_LOCATION
columns.description: Location to which the patient was discharged after the hospital stay.

columns.name: INSURANCE
columns.description: Type of insurance the patient has.

columns.name: EDREGTIME
columns.description: Date and time when the patient was registered in the Emergency Department.

columns.name: EDOUTTIME
columns.description: Date and time when the patient left the Emergency Department.

columns.name: DIAGNOSIS
columns.description: Primary diagnosis of the patient during the hospital admission.

columns.name: HOSPITAL_EXPIRE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the patient expired in the hospital (1) or not (0).

columns.name: HAS_CHARTEVENTS_DATA
columns.description: Indicates whether the patient has data in the CHARTEVENTS table (1) or not (0).
